deadline.value: January 15 for international applicants for Fall 2027 (Canadians: June 15). Admissions are rolling, so applying early helps.
deadline.quote: The Department of Chemistry follows a rolling admissions process. | International students | Fall (September) September 15 June 15 January 15

gre_subject.value: The department's pages do not mention the GRE Chemistry test.

supervisor.value: You don't need a supervisor to be admitted; you meet professors after arriving and then choose a group.
supervisor.quote: Incoming students are not committed to a supervisor before arriving at the Department of Chemistry.

funding.value: All graduate students get a funding package (CAD 28,500 a year), guaranteed for 5 years in the PhD; international students get a scholarship covering the fee supplement.
funding.quote: Support is guaranteed for 2.5 years in the MSc and 5 years in the PhD. | Students paying the Fee Supplements (Out-of-Province and International) will receive a scholarship to offset those costs.

entry_route.value: You can apply with a master's, or directly from a bachelor's with a CGPA of at least 3.7.
entry_route.quote: Applicants applying directly from a B.Sc. to a Ph.D. without completing an M.Sc. must have a minimum cGPA of 3.7.
